summary: Frontend-only verification of 6 new analytical report pages (Saldo per Periode, Penerima L/P per Periode, Tidak Disetujui, Tren, Anggota per Usia, Rating CU). Logged in as admin and visited each route via sidebar links. All sidebar data-testids present (nav-laporan-saldo-periode, nav-laporan-penerima-periode, nav-laporan-tidak-disetujui, nav-laporan-tren, nav-laporan-usia, nav-laporan-rating). Each page renders report-paper, report-table, report-signatures, report-excel-btn, report-print-btn with no console errors (only harmless Recharts width warning on first render). Spot checks: Saldo bulan=12 rows starting Januari; Penerima bulan=12 rows, triwulan switch yields 4 rows starting 'Triwulan 1'; Tidak Disetujui table filters by hasil (switch to Ditunda works); Tren chart SVG renders + 12-month table; Anggota per Usia default meninggal shows JUMLAH footer = 54 anggota (matches seed 54 permohonan) with CU=all & tahun empty, and radio an-filter-dasar-masuk switches the second-column header to 'Usia Masuk Anggota'; Rating CU with tahun=2026 lists all 6 seed CUs each with n_meninggal=9 (ties broken by cair). All assertions in the review request validated.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs a one-time width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial mount before the parent 230px container measures. Chart still renders correctly. Harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: LaporanAnalitik.jsx usePeriodRows uses r.analisis?.[k] for sanduk/lalau/total; correctly uses *_disetujui amounts (post-analysis approved values). Good.

LapTidakDisetujui builds 'alasan' by concatenating analisis.catatan_* arrays and filters out the standard 'sesuai Saldo Permohonan' noise. Reasonable, though it joins without delimiters between arrays — may read as a run-on sentence. Consider '; ' separator for readability.
LapRating sort tie-breaker uses .cair as secondary — when sorting by n_meninggal and all CUs are equal, order remains alphabetical by seed insertion. Fine.
LapUsia bucket math: lo===0 ⇒ a<=hi, else lo<a<=hi; the half-year offset (+0.5 for non-exact birthdays) in ageYears can shift someone born on same day across boundaries. Minor edge case.
ReportShell applies no-print to filters & action buttons; print output shows kop, title, table, signatures only. Correct.
exportExcel reads #report-table id; both ReportTable and PencairanTable use the same id — fine since only one is on screen per route.
seed_data_creation: None. No TEST_ data was created or deleted; seed CUG-001..006 x 9 permohonan untouched; settings.nomor_berikutnya unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new report pages confirmed rendering + filter wiring + core data assertions. Seed data remains Antrian Analisis for 54 permohonan year 2026. If a new iteration needs to exercise Saldo/Penerima/Tren with non-zero disbursement totals, create TEST_ CU + TEST_ permohonan via API, run analysis, pencairan + iuran, then DELETE pencairan→permohonan→iuran→CU and reset settings.nomor_berikutnya=1 (see iteration_2 for pattern).
